answer: A newcomer grows a willow branch: three linked jobs where each output feeds the next, like a walnut cracked to reveal the next shell, each link re-run live by a different unrelated client staking 5 POA. The nth identity from one wallet grows n branches, each stake multiplied by n, so the bond is 15n² POA — 1st 15, 10th 1,500, 5,775 across ten. A missed tide prunes the branch and slashes the bond, so clones cannot share one chain's honest work.
